scope: Whole scanout bytes against independent retained pixels. Fill counts are native explicit fills only; packed-equivalent bytes count two pixels per byte, not nibble-edge bus traffic. Launches include glyph/overlay lists. Painter CPU excludes native IRQ and off-Task time; settled time includes two PAL frames, not DMA duration.
limitations: One matched sample per scene; no percentile or latency acceptance claim.
Stage 1 boot/hide work is excluded from fill comparisons.
Read-only breakpoint packets correlate via the existing FindTask return, qualified against emitted native call sites; no emulator changes.
Painter CPU includes synchronous fence waits, gateway tails and bus stalls; actual DMA BUSY edges are unavailable.
Shared desktop/widget checks were frozen before isolation; the new comparison uses a418ccf exclusively.
No demo refresh or release qualification in this supplemental validation.
